title: ReviewArtifact
description: Engine-written findings sidecar for the review phase (#1124, FR-006). Path: <checkout>/.generacy/review-findings-<sanitizedWorkflowId>.json. verdict is engine-computed (FR-007); any agent-claimed verdict is ignored and overwritten.

verdict.description: changes-required iff >=1 open finding with severity >= blockingSeverity; else clean.

round.description: Current review pass. Increments per review re-entry on the same issue/branch (FR-009).

lastReviewedCommitSha.description: HEAD SHA of the checkout at the time this round reviewed the diff.
